incident_open_auto_idx.name: incident_open_auto_idx
incident_open_auto_idx.where: "incident"."auto" and "incident"."resolved_at" is null and "incident"."monitor_id" is not null

monthly_report_recipient_attempt_chk.name: monthly_report_recipient_attempt_chk
monthly_report_recipient_attempt_chk.value: ("monthly_report_recipient"."state" = 'prepared' and "monthly_report_recipient"."attempted_at" is null and "monthly_report_recipient"."decided_at" is null) or ("monthly_report_recipient"."state" = 'attempted' and "monthly_report_recipient"."attempted_at" is not null and "monthly_report_recipient"."decided_at" is null) or ("monthly_report_recipient"."state" in ('accepted', 'uncertain', 'skipped') and "monthly_report_recipient"."attempted_at" is not null and "monthly_report_recipient"."decided_at" is not null)

oncall_layer_shift_chk.name: oncall_layer_shift_chk
oncall_layer_shift_chk.value: ("oncall_layer"."rotation_type" <> 'custom' and "oncall_layer"."shift_length_hours" is null) or ("oncall_layer"."rotation_type" = 'custom' and "oncall_layer"."shift_length_hours" between 1 and 2016)
